responsibility: Declares the state-graph specialization of GCC’s diagnostic graph subsystem for modeling program memory and object state. It defines the node_kind taxonomy for globals, code, stack frames, heap, variables, fields, elements, and dynamic-allocation buffers; the node_dynalloc_state enum; the SARIF property-bag key prefixes for state graphs; and state_node_ref, a wrapper that interprets a generic diagnostics::digraphs::node as a memory-region/state node with typed attributes such as name, type, value, index, logical location, and allocation state. It also declares the state-graph-specific GraphViz builder entry point used to render these enriched graphs for diagnostic presentation.
same_name_distinction: Declares the state-graph specialization layered on diagnostic-digraphs, introducing the node_kind and node_dynalloc_state enums, SARIF property-key prefixes, state_node_ref wrapper, and the specialized dot-rendering entry point. Unlike diagnostic-state-graphs.cc, it defines the public state-graph API and taxonomy rather than the enum-string mappings and accessor implementations.
